status: stage1 probe analysis; official F0 3k 10-seed eval pending
subject: Does the F0 no-force baseline reproduce the F2 0.43 mid-band collapse?

data_sources.f0_probe_log: /workspace/fwv1/logs/f0_v3_baseline.log (grip_probe field every 500 steps; 2 val samples, 32-step infer)

early_10_1000.reading: early mid-band; open mode present only at step 10

late_1500_3000.reading: closed-biased single band; open mode absent in all late probes

exec_lt_030_series.definition: fraction of executed steps with act_grip_raw (V3 opening command) < 0.30

step_matched_3k.reading: at the 3k boundary F0 is closed-biased (median 0.29, probe <0.30 62.5%) while F2 sits at 0.39 with only 1.05% <0.30

comparison.caveat: F0 probe = 2 fixed val samples x 32-step predictions; F2 numbers = executed closed-loop commands over 10 seeds. Direction is clear but the official F0 3k eval is the arbiter.

hypotheses_ranked.claim: the force bundle (FiLM + force history + aux force head/loss + dropout) is associated with the release-band 0.43 bias; without it F0 goes closed
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: step-matched 3k: F0 probe closed 62.5% vs F2 1.05% <0.30; F2 series stays 0.39-0.45 from 3k to 15k while F0 drops to 0.24-0.31
hypotheses_ranked.weakness: probe vs eval protocol; no 6k-15k F0 points yet

hypotheses_ranked.claim: shared continuous V3 + flow-MSE training can produce degenerate modes; F0 closed-only is another degenerate mode
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: F0 open_ge_0.8 = 0 in every late probe; F2 open_cmd is only 1.75%-2.9%; neither model learns a healthy open/close bimodal policy
hypotheses_ranked.weakness: open may be rare in the val observations; needs per-phase eval

hypotheses_ranked.claim: the approach/open failure is a separate axis from the close-band bias; it appears in both F0 and F2
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: F0 late open 0%; F2 3k open 1.75%, 15k open 2.92%
hypotheses_ranked.weakness: probe uses fixed val observations; the rollout may open more

falsification_plan: official F0 3k 10-seed eval (seeds 7100-7109): executed open_cmd_frac, <0.30 fraction, median, in_target
F0 6k/9k/12k/15k probes + official evals: if F0 drifts to 0.43 mid-band by 15k, H1 loses; if it stays closed/bimodal, H1 gains
F2 3k paired eval (same seeds, frozen sim) to make the 3k contrast like-for-like
conclusion: At stage1 the no-force F0 does not reproduce the F2 0.43 mid-band: it becomes closed-biased (late-probe median 0.29, <0.30 62.5% at 3k, open 0%). F2 at 3k is still at 0.39 with 1.05% <0.30 and only moves to 0.43 later. This is evidence that the force bundle is associated with the release-band bias, but it is not proof: the F0 probe is small, the official 3k eval is pending, and the decisive test is the F0 6k-15k trajectory. No causal claim yet.

actions.eval: F0 3k official eval running; F2 3k paired next; r sweep queued
